description: This file defines a SwiftUI view named CronJobEditor, which provides a user interface for creating or editing scheduled Cron jobs in the application. It includes form fields for setting job parameters such as name, description, schedule type, payload, and delivery options, along with associated logic for managing state and UI interactions.

classes.name: CronJobEditor
classes.description: A SwiftUI view for editing and creating cron jobs with various scheduling and payload options.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the SwiftUI view layout including sections for basics, schedule, payload, and actions.

methods.name: hydrateFromJob
methods.description: Initializes the form fields based on the provided CronJob.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates input and triggers the onSave callback with configured job data.

methods.name: gridLabel
methods.description: Helper for creating labels in the form grid layout.
